future_check: Re-run both seed families after any probability or morphology change; require nonzero strict and thin-rectangle support in every band.
rationale: Claim: exact-profile-only generation would anchor scale but encourage template memorization; unconstrained generalization would drift off the canonical manifold. The first candidate made thin rectangles absent in medium, which the semantic gate exposed. The final discriminator is two disjoint 600-draw censuses. Result: strict linked support is 22/200, 109/200, 46/200 in the tuning census and 34/200, 105/200, 49/200 in stability, while all bands also cover thin/thick rectangles and every slant. Consequence: keep the canonical prior and generalized branch jointly measured rather than optimizing one marginal.
summary: Mix exact linked canonical profiles with generalized rectangle morphologies in every band.
